input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/rollup.ts

The rollup scheduler ticks hourly and relies on isRollupDue()/startOfWeek() to decide, for each user, whether "now" falls within the first day of their local week at SEND_HOUR. For a timezone with a large positive UTC offset like Sydney (UTC+10/+11), the local-hour and week-start calculations appear to go out of sync with the actual local calendar day near the week boundary, so the 08:00 local-time match ends up landing on Tuesday instead of Monday. Users in timezones close to UTC (e.g. London) aren't affected, which matches the reporter's observation. The fix should be in how `isRollupDue`/`startOfWeek` derive the local day-of-week/day-boundary from `now` and `user.timezone` in this file (likely a knock-on of how `util/dates.ts` computes local day boundaries, but the scheduling logic that consumes it lives here).
